global: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth with tender chashu, crisp menma, and naruto fish cake arranged neatly atop golden noodles. Served in a white bowl with red script, it rests on a dark wooden table under warm, ambient lighting.

regions.background: Dark wooden table surface with smooth, slightly reflective finish and subtle grain patterns visible.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with red Japanese characters and logo on its rim, smooth glossy surface.
regions.soup: The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is amber-brown, glossy, and rich, cradling yellow noodles and green scallions in a smooth, savory surface.
regions.meat: Chashu pork: tender, light brown slice with pinkish hue, slightly curled edges, smooth surface, and faint marbling.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, with layered, slightly curled texture and visible fibrous surface details.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: pale, slightly translucent, oval-shaped with pink swirl pattern on its surface.
